mapper.sql: cp.id, cp.plan_code AS planCode, cp.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.status AS projectStatus, pm.project_role AS actorProjectRole, cp.name, cp.purpose, cp.owner_id AS ownerId, owner.username AS ownerName, cp.source_type AS sourceType, cp.metric_definitions_json AS metricDefinitionsJson, cp.linked_experiment_record_id AS linkedExperimentRecordId, linked_record.record_code AS linkedExperimentRecordCode, cp.retention_note AS retentionNote, cp.status, cp.version, cp.created_by AS createdBy, cp.create_time AS createTime, cp.update_time AS updateTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_collection_batch counted_batch WHERE counted_batch.plan_id=cp.id) AS batchCount, latest_batch.id AS latestBatchId, latest_batch.batch_code AS latestBatchCode, latest_batch.status AS latestBatchStatus, latest_batch.create_time AS latestBatchCreateTime

cb.id, cb.batch_code AS batchCode, cb.plan_id AS planId, cp.name AS planName, cp.owner_id AS planOwnerId, cb.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.status AS projectStatus, pm.project_role AS actorProjectRole, cb.source_type AS sourceType, cb.status, cb.operator_id AS operatorId, operator.username AS operatorName, cb.started_at AS startedAt, cb.completed_at AS completedAt, cb.record_count AS recordCount, cb.rejected_count AS rejectedCount, cb.observed_from AS observedFrom, cb.observed_to AS observedTo, cb.source_revision_id AS sourceRevisionId, cb.completion_reason AS completionReason, cb.checksum, cb.version, cb.create_time AS createTime, cb.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT project_role FROM lab_project_member WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT project_id FROM lab_experiment_record WHERE id=#{recordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_collection_plan(plan_code, project_id, name, purpose, owner_id, source_type, metric_definitions_json, linked_experiment_record_id, retention_note, status, version, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{planCode}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{purpose}, #{ownerId}, #{sourceType}, #{metricDefinitionsJson}, #{linkedExperimentRecordId}, #{retentionNote}, 'DRAFT', 1, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_collection_plan SET plan_code=#{code} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE lab_collection_plan SET status=#{toStatus}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_collection_batch(batch_code, plan_id, project_id, source_type, status, operator_id, started_at, record_count, rejected_count, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{batchCode}, #{planId}, #{projectId}, #{sourceType}, 'CREATED', #{operatorId}, #{startedAt}, 0, 0, 1, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_collection_batch SET batch_code=#{code} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_collection_batch cb JOIN lab_collection_plan cp ON cp.id=cb.plan_id JOIN lab_project p ON p.id=cb.project_id LEFT JOIN lab_project_member pm ON pm.project_id=cb.project_id AND pm.user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id=cb.operator_id WHERE cb.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_collection_batch WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status=#{status}

SELECT dir.id FROM lab_data_import di JOIN lab_data_import_revision dir ON dir.id=di.current_revision_id WHERE di.batch_id=#{batchId} AND di.status='CONFIRMED' AND dir.status='CONFIRMED' ORDER BY dir.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN quality_status='GOOD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recordCount, SUM(CASE WHEN quality_status='REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, MIN(observed_at) AS observedFrom, MAX(observed_at) AS observedTo FROM lab_collection_record WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}

SELECT id, source_type AS sourceType, metric_code AS metricCode, value_type AS valueType, value_text AS valueText, unit, observed_at AS observedAt, quality_status AS qualityStatus, data_import_revision_id AS dataImportRevisionId, manual_record_revision_id AS manualRecordRevisionId FROM lab_collection_record WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY observed_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id FROM lab_collection_batch WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT di.id, di.batch_id AS batchId, cb.project_id AS projectId, di.object_key AS objectKey, di.original_file_name AS originalFileName, di.mime_type AS mimeType, di.file_size AS fileSize, di.file_sha256 AS fileSha256, di.status, di.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, di.version, di.uploaded_by AS uploadedBy, di.create_time AS createTime, di.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_data_import di JOIN lab_collection_batch cb ON cb.id=di.batch_id WHERE di.batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY di.id LIMIT 1

SELECT di.id, di.batch_id AS batchId, cb.project_id AS projectId, di.object_key AS objectKey, di.original_file_name AS originalFileName, di.mime_type AS mimeType, di.file_size AS fileSize, di.file_sha256 AS fileSha256, di.status, di.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, di.version, di.uploaded_by AS uploadedBy, di.create_time AS createTime, di.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_data_import di JOIN lab_collection_batch cb ON cb.id=di.batch_id WHERE di.id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_data_import(batch_id, object_key, original_file_name, mime_type, file_size, file_sha256, status, version, uploaded_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{batchId}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFileName}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileSha256}, 'UPLOADED', 1, #{uploadedBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, data_import_id AS dataImportId, import_revision_no AS importRevisionNo, mapping_json AS mappingJson, mapping_digest AS mappingDigest, status, record_count AS recordCount, rejected_count AS rejectedCount, previous_revision_id AS previousRevisionId, created_by AS createdBy, confirmed_by AS confirmedBy, confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, create_time AS createTime FROM lab_data_import_revision WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id, data_import_id AS dataImportId, import_revision_no AS importRevisionNo, mapping_json AS mappingJson, mapping_digest AS mappingDigest, status, record_count AS recordCount, rejected_count AS rejectedCount, previous_revision_id AS previousRevisionId, created_by AS createdBy, confirmed_by AS confirmedBy, confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, create_time AS createTime FROM lab_data_import_revision WHERE data_import_id=#{importId} ORDER BY import_revision_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_data_import_revision(data_import_id, import_revision_no, mapping_json, mapping_digest, status, record_count, rejected_count, previous_revision_id, created_by, create_time) VALUES(#{dataImportId}, #{importRevisionNo}, #{mappingJson}, #{mappingDigest}, 'MAPPING_REQUIRED', 0, 0, #{previousRevisionId}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_data_import_revision SET status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE data_import_id=#{importId} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND id<>#{exceptId}

UPDATE lab_data_import_revision SET status='CONFIRMED', record_count=#{recordCount}, rejected_count=#{rejectedCount}, confirmed_by=#{actorId}, confirmed_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='MAPPING_REQUIRED'
UPDATE lab_collection_batch SET status='REVIEW_REQUIRED', version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING','REVIEW_REQUIRED') AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_collection_record(batch_id, data_import_revision_id, manual_record_revision_id, source_type, metric_code, value_type, value_text, unit, observed_at, recorded_by, method, instrument, raw_row_no, quality_status, parser_version, create_time) VALUES(#{batchId}, #{dataImportRevisionId}, #{manualRecordRevisionId}, #{sourceType}, #{metricCode}, #{valueType}, #{valueText}, #{unit}, #{observedAt}, #{recordedBy}, #{method}, #{instrument}, #{rawRowNo}, #{qualityStatus}, #{parserVersion}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.batch_id AS batchId, cb.project_id AS projectId, mr.metric_code AS metricCode, mr.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, mr.version, mr.created_by AS createdBy, mr.create_time AS createTime, mr.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_manual_record mr JOIN lab_collection_batch cb ON cb.id=mr.batch_id WHERE mr.id=#{id}

SELECT mr.id, mr.batch_id AS batchId, mr.metric_code AS metricCode, mr.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, mr.version, revision.revision_no AS revisionNo, revision.value_type AS valueType, revision.value_text AS valueText, revision.unit, revision.observed_at AS observedAt, revision.method, revision.instrument, revision.note, revision.previous_revision_id AS previousRevisionId, revision.created_by AS recordedBy, recorder.username AS recordedByName, mr.created_by AS createdBy, mr.create_time AS createTime, mr.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_manual_record mr JOIN lab_manual_record_revision revision ON revision.id=mr.current_revision_id LEFT JOIN sys_user recorder ON recorder.id=revision.created_by WHERE mr.batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY revision.observed_at ASC, mr.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_manual_record(batch_id, metric_code, version, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{batchId}, #{metricCode}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO lab_manual_record_revision(manual_record_id, revision_no, value_type, value_text, unit, observed_at, method, instrument, note, change_reason, previous_revision_id, created_by, create_time) VALUES(#{manualRecordId}, #{revisionNo}, #{valueType}, #{valueText}, #{unit}, #{observedAt}, #{method}, #{instrument}, #{note}, #{changeReason}, #{previousRevisionId}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_manual_record SET current_revision_id=#{revisionId}, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND current_revision_id IS NULL
UPDATE lab_manual_record SET current_revision_id=#{revisionId}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, manual_record_id AS manualRecordId, revision_no AS revisionNo, value_type AS valueType, value_text AS valueText, unit, observed_at AS observedAt, method, instrument, note, change_reason AS changeReason, previous_revision_id AS previousRevisionId, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createTime FROM lab_manual_record_revision WHERE manual_record_id=#{recordId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cr.quality_status='GOOD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recordCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.quality_status='REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, MIN(cr.observed_at) AS observedFrom, MAX(cr.observed_at) AS observedTo FROM lab_collection_record cr
JOIN lab_manual_record mr ON mr.current_revision_id=cr.manual_record_revision_id
WHERE cr.batch_id=#{batchId}
AND cr.data_import_revision_id=#{sourceRevisionId} AND cr.source_type='MANUAL'

SELECT cr.id, cr.source_type AS sourceType, cr.metric_code AS metricCode, cr.value_type AS valueType, cr.value_text AS valueText, cr.unit, cr.observed_at AS observedAt, cr.quality_status AS qualityStatus, cr.data_import_revision_id AS dataImportRevisionId, cr.manual_record_revision_id AS manualRecordRevisionId FROM lab_collection_record cr
JOIN lab_manual_record mr ON mr.current_revision_id=cr.manual_record_revision_id
WHERE cr.batch_id=#{batchId}
AND cr.data_import_revision_id=#{sourceRevisionId} AND cr.source_type='MANUAL'
ORDER BY cr.observed_at ASC, cr.id ASC

SELECT id, snapshot_code AS snapshotCode, batch_id AS batchId, snapshot_type AS snapshotType, source_revision_id AS sourceRevisionId, record_count AS recordCount, rejected_count AS rejectedCount, observed_from AS observedFrom, observed_to AS observedTo, batch_checksum AS batchChecksum, mapping_digest AS mappingDigest, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createTime FROM lab_collection_snapshot WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND snapshot_type='FULL_BATCH'

SELECT id, snapshot_code AS snapshotCode, batch_id AS batchId, snapshot_type AS snapshotType, source_revision_id AS sourceRevisionId, record_count AS recordCount, rejected_count AS rejectedCount, observed_from AS observedFrom, observed_to AS observedTo, batch_checksum AS batchChecksum, mapping_digest AS mappingDigest, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createTime FROM lab_collection_snapshot WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_collection_snapshot(snapshot_code, batch_id, snapshot_type, source_revision_id, record_count, rejected_count, observed_from, observed_to, batch_checksum, mapping_digest, created_by, create_time) VALUES(#{snapshotCode}, #{batchId}, #{snapshotType}, #{sourceRevisionId}, #{recordCount}, #{rejectedCount}, #{observedFrom}, #{observedTo}, #{batchChecksum}, #{mappingDigest}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
INSERT INTO lab_snapshot_manual_revision(snapshot_id, manual_record_id, manual_revision_id) SELECT #{snapshotId}, id, current_revision_id FROM lab_manual_record WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.select: SELECT mapping_digest FROM lab_data_import_revision WHERE id=#{revisionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_experiment_record SET version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{recordId} AND version=#{recordVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO lab_request_idempotency(actor_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_digest, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{actorId}, #{operation}, #{key}, #{digest}, 'PROCESSING', #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO lab_experiment_audit_log(request_id, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, project_id, previous_status, new_status, reason, details_json, create_time) VALUES(#{requestId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{projectId}, #{previousStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{reason}, #{detailsJson}, #{now})
